item.title: Mexican student creates an acoustic fire extinguisher to put out fire in seconds
item.description:
📝 She studies at CETIS 78 in Altamira, Tamaulipas, and one day decided to put out a candle without blowing, without water, without anything but sound. That vibration pushes oxygen away from the flames, and the fire simply goes out in five to eight seconds. She tested it over and over, more than 100 times, until confirming that it also worked on wood, flammable liquids, cooking grease, and electronic equipment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.upsocl.com/en/16-year-old-mexican-student-creates-an-acoustic-fire-extinguisher-that-uses-sound-waves-to-put-out-fires-in-seconds/
